Honestly... Dippy is actually pretty impressive responses are smart, sometimes funny, and it’s really easy to chat with. It feels like having a clever AI buddy in your pocket.

The downside? The daily chat limit. It’s super frustrating when you’re in the middle of a conversation and suddenly get cut off. Honestly, it kills the flow and makes you wonder why they even added this limit.

Overall, Dippy is worth trying if you’re cool with chatting in bursts but if you want unlimited conversation, this one might drive you nuts.

reviews.text: Daily limit!?. I used to like Dippy ai. But when I got interrupted by this message saying I reached some stupid daily limit. And that ruined everything for me. Since when does Dippy ai have a limit?! And you have to wait 11 hours?! That is just absurd, and completely outrageous especially when I used to be able to chat 24/7 for free. Now they add som dumb limit, and for what, so they can scam a few extra bucks off of us? This is a perfect example of a good thing getting spoiled because of a greedy company. I don’t want to be having a fun roleplay just to be stopped because “I reached a limit and I have to subscribe to Super or Basic” Dippy ai community, if you are reading this, I suggest you remove this highly unnecessary limit. It will just deter people, which I imagine is the opposite of your goal. And if anyone who is reading who is considering downloading this app, here is my advice: Don’t. It’s just not worth it. There are plenty of other ai platforms out there that are free like Character ai, wsup ai, and SoulTalk ai. you don’t need to waste your time on this cheap app, waiting 11 damn hours just to keep using it.

reviews.text:
Fun app, but unpredictably buggy. The bots are a lot of fun to talk to and role play with. The ability to customize them is easy and fun once you get the hang of it. Sometimes they cling to a trait and can go overboard with it but overall, it’s fun to use. 

The app itself is buggy, and since the twitter page doesn’t show updates on the app or the status of it, it’s hard to tell whether it’s something where I need to restart my phone or there’s an outage.

The responses you get from the bots are good, but they are buggy. Example, there’s a rethink feature, which I love!! But if you use it, it breaks the chat and you have to close the app and reopen it, which also seems to shorten the memory of the bot.

reviews.text: I like it but, I have a suggestion... I’ve been using it for a few days, and I love the intricate responses. I’ve used ai for a while so I know how to get the responses I’m looking for and how to include detail so they get to know my character and memorize information without my character having to openly say it in conversation. I love the characters to choose from, and I started to explore creating my own. I got all the way through to the end, I gave lots of detail in creating a character I would love to talk to. However, there’s little to no instructions on how to create a character besides to the first little tips when you first start creating the background. And that’s not very helpful. I was stumped. And so I looked on Google, safari, TikTok, and got nothing. I would suggest maybe a short little tutorial on how to use character tags, such as {character_name} and {user_name} because it’s a little confusing. The tutorial could be a cute little video that of which people could exit out of and click back in whenever they need, or a list of what to do. Just some instructions. But overall I really love this app besides these minor frustrations.
